name: Rolls-Royce Power Systems (mtu)
employees: More than 10,350 worldwide at end of 2025; around 700 hires in 2025 and over 1,000 positions to be filled in 2026 (Rolls-Royce Power Systems results release, 2026-02-27)
revenue: EUR 5.72 billion in FY2025 (+19%), adjusted operating profit EUR 995 million, return on sales 17.4%, order intake EUR 7.14 billion (+21%). Reported in GBP by Rolls-Royce Holdings as Power Systems underlying revenue GBP 4,892 million and underlying operating profit GBP 852 million. H1 2026: underlying revenue GBP 2,604 million (+28% organic), operating profit GBP 528 million, margin 20.3%, order intake GBP 4.6 billion (+55%), book-to-bill 1.8x.
sector: Large diesel and gas engines, diesel and gas generator sets 40 kW to 4,000 kVA, dynamic UPS (Kinetic PowerPack), battery energy storage (EnergyPack), marine, rail and defence propulsion
positioning_text: Rolls-Royce Power Systems is the premium German engine OEM behind the mtu brand and one of the three largest suppliers of emergency power to data centres worldwide, with power generation revenue up 30% in 2025 and 41% in H1 2026 on data centre demand. Its Gulf go-to-market runs through Rolls-Royce Solutions Middle East FZE in Jebel Ali (set up as MTU Middle East in 2015) plus three distributors: Al Masaood Power Division in the UAE and Bahrain (mtu since 1978, exclusive UAE distributor since 1982), Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (Makeen), an Aramco, HD Hyundai and Dussur JV that became exclusive stationary power distributor for Saudi Arabia on 2025-10-01, and Al Mulla Power Solutions in Kuwait (sole distributor since 2024-12-22). The KSA and Kuwait channels are young: Makeen's stationary power mandate is one year old and Kuwait's mtu MRO centre in Ahmadi completes only in September 2026, while the UAE channel is mature and already wins airport and data centre work. Product range against Cummins Arabia is concentrated in the 1,600 to 4,000 kVA Series 4000 band plus the gas 20V4000 and the Kinetic PowerPack, with global genset capacity doubling in the US in 2026 and a new Series 4000 assembly plant in Friedrichshafen from 2028.

movements.headline: Upgraded mtu Series 1600 gensets launched for 50 Hz market, 590 to 996 kVA
movements.summary: New 12V1600 Gx1 based gensets deliver up to 40% more power than the predecessor, are approved for HVO (EN 15940), meet ISO 8528-5 class G3 and carry 100% load factor ratings for data centre use. Aimed at data centres, healthcare, commercial buildings and edge sites; the 60 Hz version launched in late 2023.

relevance.analysis: This pushes mtu down into the 600 to 1,000 kVA band where Cummins Arabia sells QSX15 and QSK23 based sets in volume for UAE and Kuwait 50 Hz projects. mtu's argument is data centre grade load factors and HVO approval on a compact 22 litre engine. Cummins Arabia should hold the position on price, lead time and local stock, which mtu's distributors cannot match in this band.

movements.headline: USD 24 million Mankato expansion to lift Series 4000 genset output by more than 120% by 2026
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce announced a new Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, Minnesota to raise Series 4000 generator set production more than 120% by 2026 versus the prior year, adding over 100 jobs. Data centre sales grew almost 50% in 2024; Stratmann said hyperscale customers have relied on mtu for over 15 years.

relevance.analysis: Mankato builds 60 Hz sets, the frequency Saudi Arabia runs on. More 60 Hz Series 4000 capacity shortens the lead times mtu can quote into Saudi data centre and industrial tenders from 2026. Cummins Arabia's 60 Hz lead-time advantage in KSA narrows as this ramps.

movements.headline: USD 75 million Aiken, South Carolina expansion to machine Series 4000 engines in the US from July 2027
movements.summary: Phase 1 adds 37,000 sq ft (potential 60,000 sq ft) to the Aiken engine plant so Series 4000 components are machined in-country instead of shipped finished from Germany. Construction starts Q1 2026, production July 2027, 60 new jobs on a 434 person site.

relevance.analysis: A second Series 4000 engine source reduces mtu's single-plant dependency on Friedrichshafen, which has historically capped what its Gulf distributors could deliver in a given year. Monitor mtu lead-time quotes in KSA and UAE from 2027.

movements.headline: MTU Yuchai Power JV in Suzhou adds Series 2000 G06 and Series 4000 S83 production, 3,000 engines built to date
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce's Chinese JV with Guangxi Yuchai, established 2014, expanded its scope in 2024 and now builds Series 2000 and 4000 variants for data centres, rental, industrial parks and oil and gas, including for overseas projects in neighbouring regions.

relevance.analysis: Chinese built mtu engines create a lower cost route for Chinese genset packagers exporting to the Gulf. Cummins Arabia already competes with Chinese packaged Cummins engines from Cummins' own China plants; mtu now has a comparable lever. Watch for Suzhou sourced mtu gensets appearing in UAE and KSA rental and construction tenders.

movements.headline: 50 mtu 12V4000 R64 engines ordered for Saudi Arabia's Dammam to Riyadh high-speed trains
movements.summary: Stadler ordered 50 mtu Series 4000 rail engines (1,500 kW each, EU Stage V) for 10 trains running up to 200 km/h, with an option for 40 more. The release stresses operation in extreme heat and sand.

relevance.analysis: Not a genset sale, but it puts 50 plus Series 4000 engines into Saudi Arabia with a service obligation, which strengthens the case for a Makeen Series 4000 parts and MRO base in the Eastern Province. That base would also serve stationary Series 4000 gensets sold against Cummins Arabia's QSK60 and QSK78 range.

movements.headline: Rolls-Royce and Microsoft publish joint position paper on HVO for data centre backup power
movements.summary: The paper positions HVO as a drop-in fuel cutting lifecycle CO2 by up to 90% on approved diesel gensets, written for the Singapore data centre sector with Microsoft's APAC cloud ESG team. Quoted: Ostermaier and Spadaro.

relevance.analysis: A published Microsoft co-authorship is a hyperscaler endorsement mtu will reuse in UAE and Saudi data centre bids where Microsoft, and the operators building for it, specify backup fleets. Cummins Arabia should be ready with its own HVO approval documentation for the QSK series when hyperscaler specs arrive.

movements.headline: Largest ever mtu battery order: 582 MWh / 291 MW EnergyPack for Ignitis in Lithuania
movements.summary: Three BESS sites at wind farms and a pumped storage plant, operational from 2027, controlled by mtu EnergetIQ Manager. Rolls-Royce cites over 200 mtu battery storage projects delivered worldwide.

relevance.analysis: mtu's BESS business is grid-scale and utility-led, unlike Cummins' BESS positioning. The relevance for Cummins Arabia is hybrid genset plus storage tenders in KSA and UAE, where mtu can now show half-gigawatt-hour references and its own controller. Cummins Arabia should track EnergyPack quotes into Saudi utility and NEOM-type microgrid work.

movements.headline: Fast-start mtu 20V4000 gas gensets for data centre prime and backup power, 45 second start from 2026
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce launched a 2.8 MW 20V4000 L64 gas genset with 10% better efficiency, 120 second start today and a 45 second start 60 Hz model from 2026, aimed at data centres waiting for grid connections. Existing gas genset fleets cited in the UK (500 plus), Canada and Jakarta.

relevance.analysis: This targets the same grid-constrained data centre prime power need that Cummins addresses with the HSK78G and QSK95 gas sets, and the 60 Hz variant is built for markets like Saudi Arabia. In UAE and KSA data centre campuses where gas is available, mtu can now bid diesel backup, gas prime and dynamic UPS as one package. Cummins Arabia should lead with HSK78G efficiency and Cummins' Gulf gas service record before mtu's 60 Hz set ships.

movements.headline: Makeen becomes exclusive mtu distributor for stationary power across Saudi Arabia
movements.summary: Effective 2025-10-01, Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (Makeen) extended its exclusive mtu distributorship from mobile applications to stationary power across the Kingdom, covering genuine parts, factory-certified MRO and integrated power solutions.

relevance.analysis: For the first time mtu gensets have an exclusive Saudi channel owned by Aramco, HD Hyundai and Dussur, with a localisation licence behind it. That combination speaks directly to Aramco, SEC, NEOM and IKTVA-scored buyers that Cummins Arabia sells to. Cummins Arabia's answer is installed base, 60 Hz stock and its own local content record; it should expect Makeen to appear in Eastern Province industrial and data centre tenders within 12 months.

movements.headline: Seven mtu 20V4000 DS3600 gensets for Kuwait International Airport Terminal 2
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce is supplying seven 20-cylinder Series 4000 DS3600 backup gensets through local partner Al Mulla Power Systems for the Limak-built Terminal 2, awarded by DGCA with the Ministry of Public Works. Units are specified for 55 C ambient, delivery early 2026 then commissioning.

relevance.analysis: This is mtu's first public Kuwait win through the new Al Mulla channel and it lands in the 3 MVA class where Cummins Arabia sells C3000 and C3500 class sets. A government airport reference plus a Turkish EPC relationship (Limak) gives mtu credibility for the next Kuwait infrastructure packages. Cummins Arabia should map Limak and other Turkish EPC procurement teams active in Kuwait and KSA.

movements.headline: Five-year guaranteed Series 4000 capacity agreement with UK packager AVK
movements.summary: Framework agreement secures Series 4000 emergency genset production capacity for AVK, exclusive mtu integrator for UK and Ireland, for five years, focused on HVO-ready data centre gensets. AVK has taken over 600 mtu gensets in the past decade.

relevance.analysis: Rolls-Royce is pre-selling Series 4000 capacity to European data centre packagers. That is good for Cummins Arabia in the short term because it leaves less uncommitted mtu volume for Gulf distributors, but it also signals mtu will prioritise hyperscaler channel partners; if a Gulf packager gets a similar deal, treat it as a direct threat.

movements.headline: First emergency gensets with verified Environmental Product Declarations: 16V4000 DS2500 and 10V1600
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce delivered the first data centre gensets carrying externally verified EPDs published via Environdec to a European operator, positioning EPDs as a new transparency standard for critical power.

relevance.analysis: EPDs will be asked for by hyperscalers and by UAE and Saudi green building schemes. If a UAE data centre RFP requires EPDs, Cummins Arabia needs Cummins' equivalent documentation ready or it loses on a compliance line rather than on price.

movements.headline: Rolls-Royce reports over 80% Saudisation and 450 mtu marine engines in Saudi fleets ahead of World Defense Show 2026
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce said Saudi nationals are over 80% of its Kingdom workforce, cited 450 mtu marine engines in Saudi naval and government fleets and the 50 high-speed train engines, and named Makeen as its local power solutions joint venture with its own WDS stand.

relevance.analysis: Rolls-Royce is packaging aerospace, naval and mtu activity into one Saudi localisation story, which is how it will approach GAMI, SAMI and PIF-linked buyers of power equipment. Cummins Arabia should quantify its own Saudi headcount, training and local content so procurement teams see a comparable Vision 2030 narrative.

movements.headline: Modular mtu gas engine power plants launched in 10, 20 and 30 MW blocks, 12 to 18 months to grid
movements.summary: Preconfigured, factory-tested 20V4000 L64 modules deliver plants from 5 MW to several hundred MW, hydrogen-ready and biomethane capable, for utilities, data centres and industry. Rolls-Royce cites 17 GW plus of installed gas capacity and 500 mtu gas gensets in the UK.

relevance.analysis: Modular gas blocks with a 12 to 18 month schedule are aimed at exactly the bridging power tenders that Saudi and UAE data centre developers are issuing while grid connections lag. Cummins Arabia's HSK78G offers competitive efficiency but Cummins has not published a comparable pre-engineered block product; Cummins Arabia should build a reference 10 MW HSK78G block design with local balance of plant partners.

movements.headline: FY2025: Power Systems revenue GBP 4.9bn (+19%), margin 17.4%, data centre revenue +35%, order cover 79% for 2026
movements.summary: Power generation revenue grew 30% and data centre revenue 35% in 2025; order intake GBP 6.1bn (+21%), book-to-bill 1.2x. Rolls-Royce guides power generation revenue growth of around 20% a year driven by data centres, doubled US genset capacity, and a next-generation Series 4000 with 20% higher power density launching 2028.

relevance.analysis: mtu is entering 2026 with most of its genset slots sold and margins rising, so it will not chase price in Gulf tenders; it will chase specification and hyperscaler relationships. Cummins Arabia can win on availability and total cost in 2026 but should plan for a more aggressive mtu from 2027 when new capacity frees up.

movements.headline: Al Mulla Power Solutions builds mtu MRO headquarters in Ahmadi, Kuwait, completion September 2026
movements.summary: A 5,000 sqm plot with over 3,600 sqm built-up area in Ahmadi industrial zone will house an MRO centre, workshops, spare parts, technical support, a training centre and offices, built to Rolls-Royce Power Systems standards. The 2024 agreement described stage 4 overhaul capability for four engines simultaneously.

relevance.analysis: Kuwait gets a factory-standard mtu overhaul centre next to KOC's Ahmadi operations for the first time. That closes the service gap that has favoured Cummins Arabia in Kuwait oil sector and government tenders. Cummins Arabia should lock in multi-year service agreements with Kuwait key accounts before the centre opens.

movements.headline: Al Mulla Power Solutions adds Generac as a second genset brand alongside mtu in Kuwait
movements.summary: AMPS signed with Generac Power Systems to distribute diesel, gas and bi-fuel gensets for residential, commercial and industrial customers in Kuwait, with 24/7 after-sales support.

relevance.analysis: Al Mulla is now a multi-brand house covering small Generac sets up to large mtu units, which dilutes focus but also means it will compete across Cummins Arabia's whole Kuwait range. The opportunity is that mtu no longer has a dedicated Kuwait partner; Cummins Arabia can position single-brand accountability with Kuwait government and oil sector buyers.

movements.headline: Mankato logistics centre opens; Series 4000 genset capacity more than doubles by end 2026
movements.summary: Rolls-Royce cut the ribbon on the 250,000 sq ft, USD 24 million Logistics Operations Center in Mankato, stating genset production capacity more than doubles by end of 2026 and that its backup systems support more than 25% of US data centres.

relevance.analysis: Doubled 60 Hz Series 4000 output is the supply side of a future push into Saudi Arabia's 60 Hz data centre market. Lead time, not product, has been mtu's Gulf weakness; from 2027 that argument weakens for Cummins Arabia in KSA.

movements.headline: H1 2026: Power Systems order intake +55% to GBP 4.6bn, power generation revenue +41%, margin 20.3%
movements.summary: Underlying revenue GBP 2,604m (+28% organic), operating profit GBP 528m, book-to-bill 1.8x, OE order cover about 100% for 2026 and over 50% for 2027. Rolls-Royce raised its power generation OE growth outlook to 25% a year through 2030 and cited Series 4000 gas prime power demand in data centres. CFO McCabe cited 50% plus data centre order growth.

relevance.analysis: mtu is sold out for 2026 and half sold for 2027. Any Gulf project needing Series 4000 sets inside 12 months will struggle to get mtu slots, which is a direct window for Cummins Arabia to win on delivery in UAE and KSA data centre and utility tenders through 2027.

partnerships.partner: Al Masaood Power Division (Al Masaood LLC)
partnerships.scope: Exclusive mtu distributor for UAE (1982) and Bahrain (2011), authorised importer for Iraq (2024); marine, power generation, industrial, government and renewables; team of 300 under GM Rasso Bartenschlager; also represents Leroy Somer, Volvo Penta and Instagrid; mtu gensets up to 4,000 kVA 50 Hz and 3,250 kWe 60 Hz

why_it_matters.analysis: This is the most mature mtu channel in Cummins Arabia's territory, with a competence centre in ICAD II, a Dubai Maritime City branch, a certified training centre and an award for power generation performance. It is the channel that will carry mtu into UAE data centre and government tenders against Cummins Arabia's UAE branches.

partnerships.scope: Framework licence to manufacture mtu engines and gensets for marine and off-grid power in KSA; exclusive distributor for mobile applications, extended to stationary power across KSA from 2025-10-01; parts, factory-certified MRO, technical support; JV of Saudi Aramco, HD Hyundai Heavy Industries and Dussur

why_it_matters.analysis: An Aramco-linked, PIF-linked (Dussur) owner with a licence to assemble mtu gensets in the Kingdom is the strongest localisation story any genset competitor holds in Saudi Arabia. It gives mtu an IKTVA and Vision 2030 narrative Cummins Arabia must answer with its own local content plan.

partnerships.partner: Al Mulla Power Solutions Co. (AMPS), Al Mulla Group
partnerships.scope: Sole distribution partner for mtu power solutions in Kuwait covering power generation, no-break power, Series 2000 and 4000 engines, ValueCare, reman and overhaul, microgrid and digital, energy storage; MRO centre in Ahmadi due September 2026; also Generac distributor since 2026-07

why_it_matters.analysis: Al Mulla is one of Kuwait's largest trading groups with rental, leasing and automotive reach, and it delivered the Kuwait Airport T2 order within a year of appointment. Its new MRO centre removes mtu's historical service weakness in Kuwait.

partnerships.scope: Listed in the mtu locator as service partner for power generation diesel, oil and gas and marine from a Riyadh address; SDEC's own site lists Mitsubishi generators and Develon, Bobcat and other brands, not mtu

why_it_matters.analysis: SDEC gives mtu a Riyadh service touchpoint but its own marketing does not feature mtu, which suggests a legacy or low-priority relationship. Monitor whether Makeen's new exclusive stationary power mandate displaces it.

partnerships.partner: Limak (Turkey) and Kuwait DGCA / Ministry of Public Works
partnerships.scope: Seven 20V4000 DS3600 gensets for Kuwait International Airport Terminal 2, awarded by DGCA with the Ministry of Public Works, Limak as main developer

why_it_matters.analysis: Turkish EPCs are prime contractors across Kuwait and Saudi infrastructure. A delivered mtu package with Limak becomes a template for the next airport, hospital or metro depot package.

partnerships.partner: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
partnerships.scope: 12 mtu Kinetic PowerPacks (16V4000 G74S, 1.6 MW each, 19.2 MW) protecting the Shaheen supercomputing and data centre facility, sold direct by Rolls-Royce Solutions Middle East with substantial local content after discussions since 2016

why_it_matters.analysis: KAUST is the reference mtu uses to prove dynamic UPS works in Saudi heat and in a research data centre. Cummins Arabia has no dynamic UPS product, so in tenders that specify DRUPS it needs a static UPS partner or a battery bridging design.

partnerships.scope: Joint position paper on HVO for data centre backup power; Rolls-Royce also states hyperscale customers have relied on mtu for over 15 years

why_it_matters.analysis: Hyperscaler standards travel to UAE and Saudi campuses. A documented Microsoft collaboration on fuel strategy can shape backup power specifications that favour mtu's HVO-approved range.

partnerships.scope: Five-year guaranteed Series 4000 emergency genset capacity; AVK exclusive mtu integrator for UK and Ireland, over 600 mtu gensets in a decade, HVO-ready data centre focus

why_it_matters.analysis: Shows Rolls-Royce is prepared to ring-fence factory capacity for data centre packagers. If a Gulf packager or hyperscaler obtains a similar guarantee, mtu's delivery position in the region changes overnight.

partnerships.partner: Guangxi Yuchai Machinery (MTU Yuchai Power JV, Suzhou)
partnerships.scope: Chinese production of mtu Series 4000 S83 and Series 2000 (incl. G06) engines for data centres, rental, industrial and oil and gas, including overseas projects
